property_summary: After a zero-value fallback call at block number not multiple of 15, the buggy contract sets pastBlockTime and then a subsequent 10-ether fallback at the same block number reverts because pastBlockTime is too high, while the reference contract reverts the first call so the second call succeeds.
change_summary: Change the condition 'msg.value == 10 ether' to 'msg.value == 0 ether' so that a zero-value call triggers state changes.
